No recent check-in

Check the sending program, the sending server, and the network connection to MMHotline. The missing-check-in rules below set when MMHotline warns the team and wakes the person on call.

Missing-check-in rules

After MMHotline last hears from the source:

Warning
After 2 minutes. Nobody is woken.
Wake the person on call
After 5 minutes without an alert or check-in.
Where the alert source is set

Set in /etc/mmhotline/mmhotline_settings.yml, in alert_sources. An administrator edits the settings file with sudoedit, then runs sudo mmhotline settings apply.

Planned downtime

Stop alerts about missing check-ins until the chosen time, at most 7 days ahead. Ordinary signed alerts still arrive.

Times are New York time (America/New_York), the team's time zone.
